icon_policy: preserve donor metadata; Quickstride uses packaged custom icon 30998 and Shade Shift uses packaged custom icon 30999

actions.name: Spinning Edge
actions.description: Delivers a melee attack. Damage increased when executed from behind the target.

actions.name: Shade Shift
actions.description: Allows you to evade the next two physical attacks. Effect ends after thirty seconds.

actions.name: Gust Slash
actions.description: Deals wind damage to the target.[@CR]Combo Action: Spinning Edge[@CR]Combo Bonus: Increased damage.

actions.name: Sneak Attack
actions.description: Delivers a critical melee attack. Damage increased when executed from behind the target. Damage reduced when executed from other directions. Hide nullifies the positional requirement.

actions.name: Hide
actions.description: Conceals you from sight detecting enemies. Duration varies between forty five and sixty five seconds. Ineffective against enemies with true sight. Effect ends upon reuse or when you execute an attack.

actions.name: Assassinate
actions.description: Delivers a powerful melee attack. Can only be used when the target has twenty percent HP or less.

actions.name: Steal
actions.description: Rifle through an enemy's belongings, stealing a random item. Chance of success increases when executed from behind the target or while hidden.

actions.name: Mindscatter
actions.description: Delivers a fury of attacks on the enemy.

actions.name: Trick Attack
actions.description: Delivers a melee attack. Damage increased when executed from the front of the target. Hide nullifies the positional requirement.

actions.name: Aeolian Edge
actions.description: Delivers a melee attack. Damage increased when executed from behind the target.[@CR]Combo Action: Gust Slash[@CR]Combo Bonus: Increased damage.

actions.name: Flee
actions.description: Increases movement speed by fifty percent. Effect ends after fifteen seconds and does not end when struck.

actions.name: Aura Steal
actions.description: Delivers a melee attack. Chance to steal one beneficial effect from the target. The selected effect is dispelled even when the steal attempt fails. Duration of stolen effect varies between sixty and one hundred twenty seconds.

actions.name: Shadow Fang
actions.description: Delivers a melee attack.[@CR]Combo Action: Spinning Edge[@CR]Combo Bonus: Increased damage and chance to inflict a bleed effect.

actions.name: Dancing Edge
actions.description: Delivers a fourfold melee attack.[@CR]Combo Action: Gust Slash[@CR]Combo Bonus: Increased damage and chance to reduce defense and evasion.

actions.name: Viper Bite
actions.description: Delivers a melee attack. Chance to inflict Poison, Evasion Down, and Defense Down.

actions.name: Whirlwind Edge
actions.description: Delivers a melee attack to nearby enemies.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.description: Grants an additional strike to your next weaponskill.

actions.name: Goad
actions.description: Gradually restores TP to self and nearby party members.

traits.name: Enhanced Shade Shift
traits.description: Increases the number of physical attacks evaded by Shade Shift to three.

traits.name: Enhanced Hide
traits.description: Increases damage dealt by Sneak Attack and Trick Attack while Hide is active by 5%.

traits.name: Enhanced Sneak Attack
traits.description: Increases damage dealt by Sneak Attack by 10%.

traits.name: Enhanced Trick Attack
traits.description: Increases damage dealt by Trick Attack by 10%.

traits.name: Enhanced Debilitation
traits.description: Increases the potency of enfeebling effects by 10.
